specs.title: clears conversation without error block
can send a message after /clear
stop then /clear does not produce error
lists the sockets this server is really serving and marks the one that asked
disconnects a raw client with the terminal close code, and refuses an id nobody owns
a real page that is disconnected stays down and comes back only when asked
marks the connection whose session is mid-turn, and only that one
native model capabilities, effort changes and account usage work without another provider
unsupported attachment keeps the draft and does not start a turn
Models tab shows Effort and Thinking controls
slash menu shows Effort dots and Thinking toggle
clicking effort dot in modal updates label and can be saved as the default
clicking effort dot in slash menu can be saved as the default
clicking thinking toggle in modal flips its state and can be saved as the default
clicking thinking toggle in slash menu can be saved as the default
effort and thinking are restored from config on reconnect
modal shows restored effort after reconnect
thinking=false forces --effort low in the CLI spawn log
selected effort level is forwarded to the CLI spawn log
clicking a model row in the modal can be saved as the default
selecting Default (CLI) in the modal clears the stored model
selecting a model in the slash menu can be saved as the default
model persists across reconnect - slash menu hint shows model name
model search in the modal filters the list
selected model is forwarded to the CLI spawn log
debug log auto-scrolls to the bottom throughout a stream
